# Geometry coverage — every current-epoch seat that is not drawable

**Generated — do not edit.** `npm run registry -- geography missing --write`. The totals are in [coverage.md](coverage.md); this is the per-seat account behind the ones that are missing.

**4445 of 4812 drawable. 367 are not**, and each one is a row below with the reason it is not, taken from the registry rather than from a list.

| status | what it means | seats |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **NO-TRUSTWORTHY-GEOMETRY** | the epoch draws most of its seats and this one matched no polygon on any pair of independent keys. | 234 |
| **SECONDARY-SOURCE-CANDIDATE** | a declared source covers the jurisdiction and house, and nothing resolved to this epoch. The epoch failed, not the seat. | 82 |
| **WRONG-FRAME** | a polygon is held in a different projection from its neighbours, so it cannot be drawn beside them. | 31 |
| **EPOCH-BLOCKED** | no declared source covers this jurisdiction and house, and the epoch holds no polygon at all. Nothing to match against, so nothing is guessed. | 20 |
